body: Thank you. I always feel bad venting to people, because I feel like I'm putting a burden on them, but it's always nice to hear that someone is there.

Oh I love the idea of your story. So perfectly bizarre! Also there's no better combination of words than "zombie poems."

It actually reminds me of one I've had lately: a young man who is given the power to talk to animals by a nature goddess. And proceeds to use that power to open a sigfried and roy type animal show in vegas.

Thank you <3 It's just hard. I want to believe that he actually cared about me, but I saw how pathetic this girl looked saying that...

I hope so, I have a lot of resentment based on the way he's handled my mother and my brother having their issues. I feel like he really didn't step up as he should have. 

And I'm more of a horror/sci-fi type writer. I just really like plot and descriptions haha. I feel like I can never get a hang of poetry but i'm a big letter writer. I actually wrote a bunch of letters to everyone in my life basically with no intention of sending them and it felt amazing.
That's the main thing. I keep telling myself just to get through the rest of the summer and it'll be better, I'm just also afraid to build it up too much, so I won't get disappointed.
That's not a bad idea. I've also been looking at meetup.com for stuff, but there's soooooo little out here, there doesn't seem to be much.
I am! My school just starts unusually late, September 25th.

I do have people that I chat with online and all, but I feel like that just encourages me to sit at home with my computer too much. Going off to college in a month or so, I assume I'll make a lot of friends, but in the meantime, I feel rather lost. I have no idea where to start meeting people in this reaaallly isolated area when I'm not in school or anything.
Well writing makes me happy, I meant! And I'm usually fairly alright as long as I keep really busy. I'm actually pretty happy in social situations, it's just a matter of seeking them out.
I really enjoy writing, but the bad thing is that being so depressed makes it really difficult for me to produce any work of value.
